sections.heading: SAP Customer Experience buyer question and thesis
sections.body:
SAP Customer Experience / Sales Cloud — enterprise CRM with custom quote pricing only. That orientation decides whether this setup URL should exist separately from the SAP Customer Experience hub.

Buyer question: does Enterprise gating contact management change the SAP Customer Experience decision before seats scale?

Decision thesis: unlike a generic crm shortlist, SAP Customer Experience is worth it if SAP ERP-centric enterprises outweighs Custom quote only — trade-off accepted before seats scale.

Best for: SAP ERP-centric enterprises; Global sales orgs needing SAP CX alignment; Buyers with SAP implementation partners (SAP ERP-centric enterprises).

Poor fit when: SMB self-serve CRM; Transparent list-price buyers; Lightweight pipeline tools. Avoid if Custom quote only would block go-live.

sections.heading: SAP Customer Experience limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Custom quote only; High implementation overhead; Best fit inside SAP landscapes because it forces process changes or add-ons around SAP Customer Experience when contact management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Enterprise with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain contact management at the expense of Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Enterprise · contact management.

Alternative context: unlike Salesforce, SAP Customer Experience is preferable when SAP ERP-centric enterprises because contact management plus contact management match; prefer Salesforce when SMB self-serve CRM because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for SAP Customer Experience
sections.body:
Scenario: for contact management teams, recommend SAP Customer Experience when SAP ERP-centric enterprises; recommend an alternative path when SMB self-serve CRM because Custom quote only dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for contact management plus a freeze window if integrations are in the cutover path.

Final call: proceed with SAP Customer Experience when contact management plus contact management outweigh Custom quote only; walk when SMB self-serve CRM because workarounds will eat the Enterprise spend.
